@Toha3673, Hello again. Okay I did a lot more testing and I have a pattern here. Did the testing with the config set to all (6) 100’s and only “bosskilla” to ensure a boss scav would spawn. Upon first game start/load it selects Killa properly. If I then win, again it selects Killa. As long as I keep winning, it selects Killa. But as soon as I lose, it does not select Killa, and selects a random scav. Then as long as I keep losing, more random scavs. Not until I win as a random scav, will the mod spawn Killa again. So it appears that the mod is ONLY spawning the Boss if you win the current raid. Hope others also see this, and if so, it helps you troubleshoot. Thanks.

Test Scenario: Fence Reputation above 0.99 (i.e. 3.0), and config.json set to (6) 100’s and only “bosskilla”

- MUST have a Fence reputation of 1.0 or above to be eligible for a Player Scav Boss to be chosen

- Note: So new/clean profiles at rep 0.20 are not going to choose a Boss

- *** Mod is ONLY (re)choosing a Boss if you win (successfully finish) the Player Scav raid

- *** If the Player Scav dies, it will (re)chose a regular/random Scav and not a Boss

- *** Restarting the game will force a reload of the Player Scav Boss (if Fence rep is 1.0 or above)

AND REGARDING THIS:

Known conflicting mods:

  • Revingly NLE - Doesn’t reroll scav when player dies in a scav run (you wont be able to play as boss)

I ran this mod with Revingly’s [Never Lose Equipments]. I did not see it cause any “additional” issues. The PMC succeeding or dying does not effect the state of the current/next Player Scav. The issue where when a Player Scav Boss dies and it removes the boss as the next playable character happens even with absolutely no other mods installed.
